tool_input.command:
cd <repo>
git add Makefile docs/architecture.tex prfaq.pdf
git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
fix: address Copilot findings on PR #250 (make prfaq robustness, stale tool count)

- Makefile's prfaq target could report success on a broken build:
  biber errors were swallowed (|| true) and the success check only
  tested for *any* PDF at the output path, including a stale one left
  over from a prior successful run. Deleted the target PDF before each
  compile, added -halt-on-error to every pdflatex invocation, made
  every biber failure fatal, and switched the "does this file need
  biber" check from "does a same-named .bib exist" to "did pdflatex
  actually emit a .bcf" -- the real signal that \addbibresource was
  used. Verified the fix both ways: a deliberately broken .tex now
  fails the build (confirmed exit code propagates through make) and
  the real files still build clean.
- docs/architecture.tex still said "(8 tools)" for internal/mcp/ on
  the same table row whose GNUPGHOME claim I'd already corrected two
  commits ago -- missed this specific stale count on that pass.
  Updated to 21 always-on + 2 poll-gated, matching the count already
  fixed in prfaq.tex and docs/ARCHITECTURE.md.
EOF
)"
git push 2>&1
tool_input.description: Commit and push the Copilot-finding fixes
